_comment: Enemy capability surface (weapon/ability/evadeChance) is documented in docs/REFERENCE.md §1.10 — the templates below predate it and set evadeChance: 0 explicitly to preserve existing combat math. squad-combat ticket 02: `speed` is the turn-order value Combat.build_turn_queue() sorts on, same units as GameData.COMBAT_SPEED_BY_LEVEL (draft, needs balance sign-off per R§3.7a).
